run_update_types: run the update_types script to replace array() calls with wp.array types in a types.py file
refactor_replace_array_calls: refactor array() calls in a file to wp.array, wp.array2d, wp.array3d, or wp.array4d based on argument count
process_file_types: process a types.py file to update invalid attribute types for documentation generation
test_replace_array_calls: test the replace_array_calls function with various array() call patterns and argument counts
review_process_file: review the process_file function that reads, transforms, and writes back a types.py file
